title: Food & hospitality reel
description: Dynamic content for a local restaurant focused on product and atmosphere.
challenge: Showcase food and venue in under 30 seconds without feeling like a generic ad.
approach: Golden-hour shoot, dish macros and dining room shots with smooth camera movement.
result: Higher Instagram engagement and more bookings attributed to content in the first month.

title: Wedding in Valencia
description: Cinematic video and artistic photography of an intimate wedding.
challenge: Capture intimate emotion without disrupting the ceremony or missing key moments.
approach: Two operators, fast lenses and narrative edit with custom music.
result: Delivered in 10 days. The couple shared the reel on the wedding day itself.

title: Corporate event
description: Full audiovisual coverage with aftermovie and social content.
challenge: Document a one-day event and deliver social-ready assets within 48 hours.
approach: Multi-camera crew, audio sync and express edit with vertical and horizontal cuts.
result: Content published on event day. Client reused assets in newsletter and LinkedIn.

title: Product shoot
description: Premium product photography for e-commerce and social.
challenge: Elevate brand perception with limited resources and a tight timeline.
approach: Minimal set, controlled lighting and post that unifies catalogue and social.
result: Assets ready for web and launch campaign in the same week.

title: Real estate drone
description: Aerial shots for property promotion integrated into video.
challenge: Show property and surroundings in a way that conveys exclusivity and location.
approach: Sunrise flights, orbital shots and edit integrated with interior footage.
result: Centrepiece of the online sales campaign for the development.

title: Monthly social pack
description: Full content management and community for a local brand.
challenge: Keep a consistent social presence without an in-house content team.
approach: Monthly plan, block shoot days and editorial calendar aligned with business goals.
result: Coherent visual line and more direct Instagram enquiries within three months.
